svg.aria-label: Two ASCII koi, one red and white, one gold, swimming a figure eight through a dark pond. Hridya Agrawal, London. I build tools for problems I run into: a shell that understands English, a GPU video renderer, a Mac launcher, and games that end up in an arcade.
svg.title: Hridya Agrawal
svg.text: i build tools for problems i run into. a shell that understands english,
a gpu video renderer, a mac launcher, games that end up in an arcade.
